$comment: Overlay triplets applied on top of the vcpkg registry. ./triplets/x64-windows.cmake builds dependencies release-only (a debug Qt6/VTK/ITK does not fit on a CI runner's disk) and adds CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION=ON to dodge a CMake 4.x Ninja regenerate-during-build loop that breaks some ports. vcpkg auto-loads this file in manifest mode, so no extra flags are needed.
